topic: What if you could pause everyone but you?
title: WHAT IF YOU COULD
PAUSE EVERYONE BUT YOU?

power.rule: everyone and everything freezes around you while you move freely

script.beat: 4 the turn: the cost, one real fact
script.text: One catch: the power grid balances frequency sixty times a second. Without operators, relays trip the whole planet in thirty seconds. Blackout. That's real.
And you don't know how to restart it.

science.claim: The power grid balances frequency sixty times a second. Without operators, relays trip the whole planet in thirty seconds.
science.working: Synchronous AC power grids operate at 60 Hz (60 cycles per second, or 50 Hz in Europe), where supply and load must match continuously to avoid generator turbine damage. Automated Underfrequency Load Shedding (UFLS) relays trip when frequency drops below threshold (e.g. 59.5 Hz), and uncorrected imbalance causes cascading blackout across the entire grid within 10 to 30 seconds.
science.source: NERC Standard PRC-006 (Automatic Underfrequency Load Shedding); IEEE Power & Energy Magazine, Grid Stability and Frequency Control.
